requirements.description: Extension manifests strictly decode duplicate-free JSON, validate canonical SemVer 2 versions and Ziggy range grammar, exclude provenance claims, and expose deterministic build-aware and prerelease-clause compatibility without claiming install/load integration or S4 stage completion.

The closed 47-candidate Merlin migration ledger, conditional independent-review set, review freshness and budget contract, and deterministic extension-integrity gate are checked in without requiring the sibling Merlin repository.

Manifest-v2 Commands become Session Tools only after exact install approval, then execute through a daemon-supervised no-shell subprocess boundary with pinned executable identity, bounded fixed-plus-appended argv, explicit cwd and timeout, declared-only environment, bounded output, private approved-byte execution snapshots, structured outcomes, per-invocation authority revalidation, and TERM-to-KILL process-tree cancellation.

The production daemon owns Extension install, exact approval, disabled installation, list, enable, doctor, disable, and restart persistence over the real Unix attach socket while Client operations preserve direct-write canaries.

Tool-list and Skill-load seal failures durably invalidate approvals, restored immutable bytes remain rejected, explicit fresh approval reinstall recovers disabled without moving mutable state, and Extension processes receive only declared environment values.

Approved compatible enabled Tools are imported only from mode-0700 scoped execution snapshots after exact authority, path, digest, and live-seal validation; ABI, identity, schema, output, collision, mutation, and compiled post-build TypeScript boundaries fail closed.

Schema-stamped Extension publication journals recover real process death to a complete old or new generation at every durable cut point, preserve mutable-state inode identity, clean idempotently, and serialize list discovery across the package publication gap.

The HyperFrames Blueprint is a versioned Markdown edit guide with stable idempotent fixture postconditions, while the conformant baked-in skill-writing Skill is validated and injected before installed Extension Skills without adding runtime authority.
Smart Memory and Smart Extensions ship only strict content-only Extension scaffolds with no Tool, setup, doctor, command, environment, secret, network, filesystem, or mutable-state authority.
